Template.Name: Beszel Hub
Template.Description: Beszel server monitoring hub — web UI and backend. Install once per cluster.
Template.Overview: Beszel is a lightweight, self-hosted server monitoring solution. The hub provides the web interface and collects data from agents running on each server.

Template.Name: Beszel Agent (No GPU)
Template.Description: Beszel monitoring agent for servers without an Nvidia GPU.
Template.Overview: Lightweight monitoring agent that reports system stats back to a Beszel hub. Uses host networking for SSH connectivity.

Template.Name: Beszel Agent (Nvidia GPU)
Template.Description: Beszel monitoring agent with full Nvidia GPU monitoring via glibc bind-mount injection for the distroless container image.
Template.Overview: Monitoring agent with Nvidia GPU support. Requires bind-mounting glibc and nvidia-smi into the distroless container. See docs/gpu-setup.md for details.
